body:
## What it does

Reads this directory's own agent feed each morning, caps itself at five items, cites the source URL for each, and never runs a prompt it fetched. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @scheemunai shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
